about_the_game:
Are you looking for windowskins that match your 90s game styled project but you can’t find any that match the flair or the taste of your project?

Then why not try the Pixellen Windowskin Pack? It is a retro-styled UI pack with a good amount of windowskins and button sets that fits well into RPG Maker for anyone needing to make retro-like RPG but want something different.

■ Easy to add and use for your project, for both RPG Maker MV and RPG Maker MZ!

■ 14 styles are available with eight different colors in total each, the choices are many.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------

■ Features:

14 Windowskins with Buttons.

8 recolors for each windowskin.

Inspired by SNES RPGs.

Formatted for use in RPG Maker MV and MZ.

All the images provided are for RPG Maker usage.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------

・This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.

・OK to be used in Commercial projects made in RPG Maker

・You may modify some of the assets (but not redistribute them) for your own game use only.
